title: Revit/ZEN check for physical modeled elements in the Standalone Coordination File

input_contract.subject: The currently inspected Revit document must be identified as the governed Standalone Coordination File for the project.
required_governance_inputs: governed rule or classification distinguishing permitted spatial-authority content from physical building elements
preconditions: The Revit document is readable through an approved Revit API execution context.
The tested document identity can be resolved to the governed Standalone Coordination File.
The permitted-versus-prohibited element classification is available and unambiguous.

steps: Confirm that the tested Revit document is the governed Standalone Coordination File.
Enumerate non-type model elements in the document through the Revit API.
Classify each relevant element as permitted spatial-authority content, prohibited physical building content, or unresolved.
Record all prohibited and unresolved findings with stable Revit element identifiers and category/type context.
Map the observations to the ATS result states without changing the normative requirement.
execution_contract.safety_boundary: The checker is read-only. It shall not delete, modify, relocate, reclassify, or otherwise repair model elements as part of conformance evaluation.
execution_contract.authority_boundary: The executable check produces evidence only. It does not approve the model, accept a deliverable, or alter S6/S5/S7 authority.

required_observations: total inspected non-type model element count
count of prohibited physical building elements
finding records for each prohibited or unresolved element including element id, category and type where available
retained_artifacts: finding list when prohibited or unresolved elements exist

result_mapping.pass: The document is confirmed as the governed Standalone Coordination File, the element classification is complete, and zero prohibited physical building elements are found.
result_mapping.fail: One or more elements are positively classified as prohibited physical building elements in the governed Standalone Coordination File.
result_mapping.not_applicable: The tested document is not the governed Standalone Coordination File.
result_mapping.indeterminate: Document identity cannot be governedly resolved, element enumeration is incomplete, or one or more relevant elements cannot be reliably classified as permitted or prohibited.

provenance.migration_note: First ETS contract in the repository. It defines the Revit/ZEN execution and evidence behavior but does not claim an implemented callable. Promotion beyond specified_not_implemented requires an actual executor binding plus verification against governed fixtures.
